begin read only;
set local statement_timeout = '5s';
set local lock_timeout = '1s';
select jsonb_build_object(
  'snapshot_at', now(),
  'database', current_database(),
  'server_version', current_setting('server_version'),
  'read_only', current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
  'functions', (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f)) from (
    select n.nspname as schema, p.proname as name,
      pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as arguments,
      p.prosecdef as security_definer, p.provolatile as volatility,
      p.proconfig as config,
      md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) as definition_md5,
      has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as anon_execute,
      has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as authenticated_execute,
      has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as service_execute
    from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
    where n.nspname in ('public','comparator_internal')
      and (p.proname like 'catalog_cheaper_products%' or p.proname like 'catalog_embedding_candidates%'
        or p.proname in ('catalog_finalize_embedding_batch','catalog_product_identity_compatible_v1','catalog_product_family_v1','catalog_embedding_maintenance_status','catalog_embedding_pipeline_status'))
    order by n.nspname,p.proname limit 50
  ) f),
  'relations', (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) from (
    select n.nspname as schema,c.relname as name,c.relkind as kind,
      c.reltuples::bigint as estimated_rows,c.relrowsecurity as rls,c.reloptions as options
    from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
    where n.nspname in ('public','comparator_internal','pgmq','cron')
      and c.relkind in ('r','p','v')
      and (c.relname like 'catalog_embedding%' or c.relname like '%catalog_match%'
        or c.relname like '%catalog_embedding_jobs' or c.relname in ('catalog_product_embeddings','catalog_sync_runs','catalog_store_sync_status','job','job_run_details'))
    order by n.nspname,c.relname limit 60
  ) r)
) as inventory;
rollback;

begin read only; set local statement_timeout='5s'; set local lock_timeout='1s';
select jsonb_build_object(
 'columns',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from (
  select table_schema,table_name,column_name,data_type
  from information_schema.columns
  where (table_schema='comparator_internal' and table_name in ('catalog_embedding_pipeline_control','catalog_embedding_runs','catalog_embedding_run_jobs'))
    or (table_schema='public' and table_name like 'catalog_sync%')
  order by table_schema,table_name,ordinal_position limit 150) x),
 'source',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from (
  select n.nspname as schema,p.proname as name,p.prosrc as body
  from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
  where (n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('catalog_cheaper_products_v7','catalog_embedding_pipeline_status','catalog_embedding_maintenance_status'))
    or (n.nspname='comparator_internal' and p.proname='catalog_cheaper_products_v5')
  order by n.nspname,p.proname limit 4) x),
 'schemas',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from (
  select nspname,has_schema_privilege('anon',oid,'USAGE') as anon_usage,
  has_schema_privilege('authenticated',oid,'USAGE') as authenticated_usage
  from pg_namespace where nspname in ('public','comparator_internal','pgmq')) x)
) as details; rollback;

begin read only; set local statement_timeout='5s'; set local lock_timeout='1s';
select jsonb_build_object(
 'observed_at',now(),
 'control',(select to_jsonb(c) from (select mode,max_auto_jobs,max_auto_ratio,canary_max_requests,canary_remaining_requests,updated_at from comparator_internal.catalog_embedding_pipeline_control where singleton) c),
 'queue',(select jsonb_build_object('count_up_to_5001',count(*),'has_invisible',coalesce(bool_or(vt>now()),false)) from (select vt from pgmq.q_catalog_embedding_jobs limit 5001) q),
 'run_states',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) from (select status,count(*) as count from comparator_internal.catalog_embedding_runs group by status order by status) r),
 'recent_runs',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) from (select store,status,started_at,settled_at,expected_dependency_count,completed_dependency_count,terminal_failed_dependency_count,dispatch_request_count from comparator_internal.catalog_embedding_runs order by started_at desc limit 20) r),
 'maintenance',public.catalog_embedding_maintenance_status(),
 'cron_timezone',current_setting('cron.timezone',true),
 'cron',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j)) from (select jobid,jobname,schedule,active,md5(command) as command_md5,substring(command from '/functions/v1/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)') as edge_handler from cron.job order by jobid limit 100) j),
 'cron_17_recent',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j)) from (select jobid,status,start_time,end_time from cron.job_run_details where jobid=17 order by start_time desc limit 5) j),
 'syncs',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) from (select store,synced_at,updated_at from public.catalog_sync_status order by store limit 50) s),
 'activity',(select jsonb_build_object('active_sessions',count(*) filter(where state='active'),'lock_waiters',count(*) filter(where wait_event_type='Lock'),'idle_in_transaction',count(*) filter(where state='idle in transaction')) from pg_stat_activity where datname=current_database() and pid<>pg_backend_pid()),
 'hnsw_overrides',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) from (select setdatabase,setrole,v as setting from pg_db_role_setting cross join lateral unnest(setconfig) v where v like 'hnsw.%' limit 20) s)
) as state; rollback;

begin read only; set local statement_timeout='5s'; set local lock_timeout='1s';
select jsonb_build_object(
 'functions',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f)) from (
  select n.nspname as schema,p.proname as name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as arguments,
    p.proconfig as config,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) as definition_md5,
    position('hnsw.iterative_scan' in p.prosrc)>0 as body_sets_iterative_scan,
    position('relaxed_order' in p.prosrc)>0 as body_mentions_relaxed_order
  from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
  where n.nspname in ('public','comparator_internal') and p.proname in ('similar_products','similar_products_v2','catalog_product_variants_v1','catalog_embedding_semantic_name_v1','catalog_embedding_candidates_v3')
  order by n.nspname,p.proname limit 10) f),
 'queue_by_store',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)) from (
  select message->>'store' as store,count(*) as count
  from (select message from pgmq.q_catalog_embedding_jobs limit 5001) q group by message->>'store' order by store) q),
 'unsettled_runs',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) from (
  select store,status,started_at,materialized_at,expected_dependency_count,dependency_count,completed_dependency_count,already_ready_dependency_count,superseded_dependency_count,terminal_failed_dependency_count
  from comparator_internal.catalog_embedding_runs where status<>'settled' order by started_at limit 30) r)
) as reconciliation; rollback;

begin read only; set local statement_timeout='5s'; set local lock_timeout='1s';
select n.nspname as schema,c.relname as name,c.relrowsecurity as rls,
 c.reltuples::bigint as estimated_rows,
 has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'SELECT') as anon_select,
 has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'SELECT') as authenticated_select,
 has_table_privilege('service_role',c.oid,'SELECT') as service_select
from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('catalog_product_matches','catalog_product_match_cache_status')
order by c.relname; rollback;
